justification: `javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/metamodel/JavaParserMetaModel.java` is a central registry with 118 `public static final *MetaModel` fields plus `getNodeMetaModels()`, `getNodeMetaModel(...)`, and static initialization that wires all node/property meta-models together. Fan-in is high: 129 source files reference it, including core AST classes like `Node.java`, `Comment.java`, `Parameter.java`, and `Statement.java`, plus tooling such as `ConcreteSyntaxModel.java`, `JavaParserJsonSerializer.java`, and `VisitorGenerator.java`. This combination of broad incoming use and broad outgoing coupling matches hub-like modularization.
